title: A Veil for the Spire
author: Yara Okonkwo
blurb: Zephyrine Dravenmoor, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
